caseName: Buckhannon Board & Care Home, Inc. v. West Virginia Department of Health & Human Resources
caseNameFull: Buckhannon Board & Care Home, Inc. v. West Virginia Department of Health and Human Resources

opinions.text: C. A. 4th Cir. Certiorari granted. Brief of petitioners is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Monday, November 13, 2000. Brief of respondents is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Wednesday, December 13, 2000. A reply brief, if any, is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Friday, December 29, 2000. This Court's Rule 29.2 does not apply.
